#!/bin/sh
set -eu

base=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$(dirname -- "$0")/.." && pwd)
maildir=$base/Maildir

mkdir -p "$maildir/accounts/new" \
         "$maildir/support/new" \
         "$maildir/general/new" \
         "$maildir/tmp"

tmp=$(mktemp "$maildir/tmp/deliver.XXXXXXXXXX")
cleanup() {
    if [ -n "${tmp:-}" ]; then
        rm -f -- "$tmp"
    fi
}
trap 'cleanup' 0
trap 'exit 1' HUP INT TERM

cat > "$tmp"

department=$(
    LC_ALL=C awk '
        BEGIN { department = "general" }
        {
            line = $0
            sub(/\r$/, "", line)
            if (line == "") {
                exit
            }

            colon = index(line, ":")
            if (colon == 0) {
                next
            }

            name = substr(line, 1, colon - 1)
            if (tolower(name) != "x-department") {
                next
            }

            value = substr(line, colon + 1)
            sub(/^[ \t]+/, "", value)
            sub(/[ \t]+$/, "", value)
            if (value == "accounts" || value == "support") {
                department = value
                exit
            }
        }
        END { print department }
    ' "$tmp"
)

case $department in
    accounts|support) ;;
    *) department=general ;;
esac

destination=$maildir/$department/new/${tmp##*/}
mv -- "$tmp" "$destination"
tmp=
ANTRIEB_DELIVER_EOF
chmod 0755 "$new"
/bin/sh -n "$new"
chown --reference="$base/bin/deliver" "$new"
chcon --reference="$base/bin/deliver" "$new"
mv -f -- "$new" "$base/bin/deliver"
trap - 0 HUP INT TERM
printf '%s\n' '[installed]'
stat -c '%A %U:%G %s %n' "$base/bin/deliver"
sha256sum "$base/bin/deliver"
/bin/sh -n "$base/bin/deliver"
printf 'syntax=ok rollback=%s\n' "$backup"

printf 'failed-units=%s\n' "$failed"
printf '%s\n' '[final-software]'
rpm -q bash coreutils grep sed util-linux policycoreutils
printf '%s\n' '[final-task-tree]'
sha256sum "$base/bin/deliver" "$base"/samples/*.eml
for department in accounts support general; do printf '%s=' "$department"; find "$base/Maildir/$department/new" -type f | wc -l; done
printf 'all-deliveries='; find "$base/Maildir" -path '*/new/*' -type f | wc -l
printf 'unique-delivery-names='; find "$base/Maildir" -path '*/new/*' -type f -printf '%f\n' | sort -u | wc -l
printf 'delivery-temps='; find "$base/Maildir/tmp" -type f | wc -l
printf 'abandoned-script-temps='; find "$base/bin" -maxdepth 1 -name '.deliver.new.*' -type f | wc -l
printf '%s\n' '[final-security]'
getenforce
pending=$(restorecon -RFnv "$base" | wc -l)
printf 'pending-context-fixes=%s\n' "$pending"
printf '%s\n' '[final-listeners]'
ss -lntup 2>/dev/null || true
